purpose: compact seasonal context without storing the full 1901-2025 monthly archive

variables.vpd: same-calendar-month mean VPD, hPa, derived month-by-month from CRU tmp and vap

comparison.interpretation: For an event occurring in month M, compare the recent mean for month M with the 1981-2010 normal for the same month. This controls for the seasonal cycle.
comparison.not_event_month_observation: CRU-TS v4.10 ends in 2025, so current 2026 event-month weather is not represented. A near-real-time source would be needed for a true event-month anomaly.

vpd.formula: VPD = SVP - AVP; AVP = CRU vap; SVP = 6.1078*exp(a*T/(T+b)) hPa
vpd.reference: Zhong Z, Chen HW, Dai A et al. (2025), Nature Communications 16, 8247
vpd.caveat: Monthly-mean temperature omits sub-daily and diurnal temperature variability; VPD here is long-term climate context, not high-frequency atmospheric dryness.

cru_reference: Harris I, Osborn TJ, Jones P and Lister D (2020), Scientific Data 7, 109
